scripts.check: bun run check:tools && bun run format:check && bun run check:source-boundary && bun run check:extraction && bun run check:records && bun run check:docs && bun run check:deploy && bun run check:core-release && bun run check:site && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:portable && bun run build:portable && bun run build:site
scripts.check:tools: set -e; for tool in git go gofmt node; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { printf 'Required portable check tool is missing: %s\n' "$tool" >&2; exit 127; }; done
scripts.check:deploy: node --check scripts/deploy.mjs && node --check scripts/site-deploy.mjs && bun test scripts/deploy.test.mjs scripts/site-deploy.test.mjs
scripts.check:site: bun test scripts/site.test.mjs scripts/site-status.test.mjs && bun scripts/site-status.mjs --check && bun scripts/site.mjs --check
scripts.format:check: set -e; unformatted="$(gofmt -l .)"; if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then printf 'The following files need gofmt:\n%s\n' "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi
scripts.build:portable: set -e; build_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$build_dir"' EXIT; go build -o "$build_dir/" ./...
